articles.title: Lawfulness of processing
obligations: Identify a lawful basis (consent / contract / legal obligation / vital interests / public task / legitimate interests)
Document the chosen basis per purpose

articles.title: Special categories
obligations: Prohibit processing of race/health/etc. unless explicit exception (explicit consent, vital interests, etc.)

articles.title: Information not obtained from subject
obligations: Similar to Art. 13 where data not collected from the subject

articles.title: Right of access
obligations: Provide copy of personal data + processing info

articles.title: Right to erasure
obligations: Honour erasure where no overriding basis

articles.title: Right to object
obligations: Honour objection to legitimate-interest/ direct-marketing processing

articles.title: Automated decision-making
obligations: Safeguards for solely automated decisions with legal/significant effect

articles.title: Breach notification to authority
obligations: Notify supervisory authority within 72h where high risk

articles.title: International transfers
obligations: Ensure adequate protection for transfers outside EEA (adequacy decision / SCCs / BCRs)
